### Is it platform specific

generic

### Description of the enhancement

**Is it platform specific**
generic

**Importance or Severity**
Critical

**Description**
test_vxlan_vnet_bgp_subintf failed to synchronize DUT system time with NTP Server during pre-setup phase

**Steps to Reproduce**
sonic-mgmt test run

Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior
test should pass but fails

once the dut's ntp server has issue it wont fallback to ptf ntp server to have assertion
we should follow up what test_gnoi_smartswitch does.
- check dut ntp status
- if not, switch over to ptf ntp server

**Relevant log output**
Failed: Setup failed: AssertionError('Failed to synchronize DUT system time with NTP Server

resolution.description:
**Description**
test_vxlan_vnet_bgp_subintf failed to synchronize DUT system time with NTP Server

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/27044

**Details**
once the dut's ntp server has issue it wont fallback to ptf ntp server to have assertion
we should follow up what test_gnoi_smartswitch does.
- check dut ntp status
- if not, switch over to ptf ntp server

mimic the approach however, this testcase no need for config save due to no reboot behavior.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/gnmi/test_gnoi_smartswitch.py#L15
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/24495
